# ts-libs: the exports of the @spy4x/* packages on JSR, one per line.
# Columns, separated by one tab: name, kind, import specifier, summary.
# Search: git grep -n -i '<word>' origin/main -- llms.txt
# Use: deno add jsr:<package>, then import { <name> } from "<import specifier>".
# Left out: a type or interface that describes the parameters of a listed function or class Foo, foo or createFoo and is named Foo plus Props, Labels, Options, Config, Deps, Input. Its signature: https://jsr.io/<package>/doc
# Full READMEs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spy4x/ts-libs/main/llms-full.txt
BillingError	interface	@spy4x/billing	A failed request, safe to log: it never carries the secret key.
BillingErrorCode	type	@spy4x/billing	Why a request to the provider failed.
BillingEvent	type	@spy4x/billing	A verified webhook delivery, in provider-neutral terms.
BillingEventRejectReason	type	@spy4x/billing	Why a delivery was refused: the signature check's reasons, or a payload it cannot read.
BillingEventType	enum	@spy4x/billing	What happened, as the discriminant of BillingEvent.
BillingProvider	interface	@spy4x/billing	One payment provider behind one interface.
CancelAtPeriodEndRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.setCancelAtPeriodEnd needs.
CancelRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.cancelNow needs.
CheckoutRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.createCheckout needs to start a subscription checkout.
CheckoutSession	interface	@spy4x/billing	A hosted checkout page to send the customer to.
LastPaymentRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.readLastPayment needs.
PaidPayment	interface	@spy4x/billing	The newest payment that moved money for a subscription, read from the provider when asked rather than from an event, so it shows refunds made anywhere, the provider's dashboard included.
ParseEventResult	type	@spy4x/billing	Result of BillingProvider.parseEvent.
Payment	interface	@spy4x/billing	A payment, successful or failed, as an event reports it.
PaymentEvent	interface	@spy4x/billing	A payment that went through or failed.
PlanRef	interface	@spy4x/billing	One of the app's plans, mapped to the provider's price that bills it.
PortalRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.createPortalSession needs.
PortalSession	interface	@spy4x/billing	A customer portal page, where the customer changes plan, card or cancels and sees invoices.
QuantityRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.updateQuantity needs to change how many seats a plan bills.
Refund	interface	@spy4x/billing	A refund the provider created.
RefundRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.refundPayment needs to refund a payment in full.
RefundStatus	enum	@spy4x/billing	Where a refund stands.
STRIPE_API_VERSION	constant	@spy4x/billing	The Stripe API version every request is pinned to.
STRIPE_SIGNATURE_HEADER	constant	@spy4x/billing	Stripe's `Stripe-Signature: t=<seconds>,v1=<hex>[,v1=<hex>][,v0=<hex>]` header layout.
Subscription	interface	@spy4x/billing	A subscription as an event reports it.
SubscriptionEvent	interface	@spy4x/billing	A subscription created, changed or ended.
SubscriptionStatus	enum	@spy4x/billing	Where a subscription stands, as every provider reports it.
TrialEndRequest	interface	@spy4x/billing	What BillingProvider.setTrialEnd needs to give a subscription time at no charge.
createStripeBilling	function	@spy4x/billing	A Stripe BillingProvider.
STRIPE_API_VERSION	constant	@spy4x/billing/stripe	The Stripe API version every request is pinned to.
STRIPE_SIGNATURE_HEADER	constant	@spy4x/billing/stripe	Stripe's `Stripe-Signature: t=<seconds>,v1=<hex>[,v1=<hex>][,v0=<hex>]` header layout.
createStripeBilling	function	@spy4x/billing/stripe	A Stripe BillingProvider.

sameResource	function	@spy4x/caldav/url	Whether two absolute URLs name the same resource: same origin, same query and the same path segments once each segment is percent-decoded.

isSafeEntityId	function	@spy4x/caldav/write	Whether an entity id can name an object: letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `~` and `-`, and not `.` or `..`.
objectUrl	function	@spy4x/caldav/write	The address createCalDavWriteTransport gives a created entity's object.

frameInstantLong	function	@spy4x/email	Render an instant as the recipient's own clock reads it, with the zone spelled out: `"Friday, 28 August 2026 at 04:00 (America/New_York)"`.
frameInstantShort	function	@spy4x/email	frameInstantLong without the zone name, for a subject line: `"Fri 28 Aug 04:00"`.
frameWallClockLong	function	@spy4x/email	Frame a `YYYY-MM-DD` + `HH:MM` wall clock written in `sourceTz` for a recipient in `recipientTz`, falling back to the zone the wall clock was written in.
frameWallClockShort	function	@spy4x/email	frameWallClockLong without the zone name, for a subject line.
